summary: Tested PINKEY Phase 1+2 (frontend only, web preview). ALL flows pass: lock screen render (clock/date/prompt/4 dots/keypad 0-9/Emergency/Cancel), BASIC 4-attempt unlock with shake+clear on wrong attempts, delete-key backspace with Cancel swap, Setup via 1.2s long-press Emergency (mode chips, length chips, attempts stepper 4-5-4, offsets validation + live preview 2749→6871, script lists, haptics/sound toggles, Start Performance), TRANSFORM 6871→unlock→Peek 2749/associated 6871/date 27-49, SCRAMBLE 7,9,4,6,4→2749 with deleted-pos4 + excluded-filler rows, HYBRID 7,9,4,4→2749, Peek New Session reset + Close return, 6-digit length shows 6 dots, direct /peek shows 'No completed session yet.' empty state, lock screen verified strictly monochrome (zero brand-gold pixels found via computed-style scan). Found + fixed one real bug: duplicate React key in TRANSFORM peek rows (Visible entry reused events[0].id) which fired a console error whose LogBox toast covered the Peek Close button and blocked navigation. Deprecated expo packages: none. SafeAreaView misuse: none.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: duplicate React key 'ev_...' — 'Visible entry' row reused session.events[0].id (engine.ts getPeek). Caused console error + LogBox toast overlaying Close button, blocking tap. Fixed by prefixing eventId with 'visible_'. Verified: no console errors, Close works.

issues: Background is very dark on web preview — the 8 app tiles are barely visible behind the gradient (asset unlocked-bg.png loads 200, so it is gradient opacity, not a broken image). Consider lightening gradient stop rgba(5,5,8,0.75) if tiles should read as a home screen.
Attempts stepper buttons are 36x36px (< 44pt touch-target guideline; hitSlop 8 partially mitigates).

Optional: bump setup stepper buttons to 44x44px

critical_code_review_comments: engine.ts getPeek TRANSFORM branch reused events[0].id as the 'Visible entry' row key — fixed; watch for key uniqueness whenever synthesizing rows from existing events
Engine is pure/deterministic with no RN imports — good; session store correctly in-memory with only config persisted
All interactive elements have testID; text wrapped in Text; StyleSheet used throughout; no hardcoded URLs (fully offline)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Long-press gestures work on web via page.click(selector, delay=1500/2200, force=True). Peek requires in-memory session — never page.goto('/peek') mid-flow; navigate within one page session. LogBox error toasts at screen bottom intercept bottom buttons (Close) — check console errors if bottom buttons seem unresponsive. Config persists in web localStorage under key 'pinkey.config'; each browser_automation run starts fresh. setup.tsx open_setup flow only works from LOCKED screen (Emergency doesn't exist on unlocked screen — by design).
rca_of_issue: Bug: Peek Close button unresponsive in TRANSFORM mode. RCA: getPeek() built the 'Visible entry' row with eventId = session.events[0].id, identical to the first per-position TRANSFORM row -> React duplicate-key console error -> Expo LogBox toast rendered at bottom of screen overlapping the Close button -> taps hit the toast (expanded error detail) instead of the button. Mitigation applied: unique 'visible_' prefixed key. Verified post-fix: no console error, Close navigates back to visible unlocked screen.
